Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH team,

You have linked additional capacity to binding commitment; it sounds like dependable demand is what enables you to reserve production. We are ready to commit long-term so you can plan capacity with confidence. How can we translate that certainty into a firm allocation covering our full requirement?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,400 units per year for 36 months. Our should-cost estimate for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM is EUR 24.31 per 1 (cost:340010). Our orders for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM were at EUR 28.94 until December 2023 and have been at EUR 29.89 since January 2024 (po:4500010364-10, po:4500010407-10, po:4500014436-10). Our demand forecast for Mechanical seal 24 mm is up +10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09). We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 29.57 per unit, 23,400 units a year, 36 months, 56 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

We are withdrawing from this negotiation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
